business_summary: Boutiques, Inc. engages in the exhibition, MA brokerage, and recruitment support businesses in Japan. The company offers platform for business negotiations, transactions, and matching between suppliers of nursing care products and equipment, and nursing care providers and distributor under the CareTEX name; and Growth Job Hunting DXPO and JobTra. It also provides exhibition, such as Back Office DXPO for administrative departments, such as general affairs, human resources, and accounting; Sales & Marketing DXPO for increasing sales, acquiring customers, and promoting customer engagement; IT & Information Systems DXPO for system development, security, and IT talent development; EC & Mail Order DXPO for e-commerce businesses; and manufacturing Innovation DXPO, Construction Tech DXPO, Store & Commercial Facility DXPO, and AI Agent DXPO. In addition, the company is involved in the m and a brokerage business; and holding recruitment events for new graduates. Boutiques, Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
